name: Tormás (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner with a yellow horizontal band at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Tormás (a shield of red, green and blue with ears of grain and a tree) within a yellow wreath, above a scroll inscribed TORMÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tormás arms with wreath and scroll
